scope: one training-selected contiguous categorical motif per snapshot with a frozen test region and a training-fitted Huffman comparator

design.split: positive training and test counts, nonnegative guard, disjoint prefixes in snapshot order; at most 4096 symbols in each scored region
design.fit: admit the shortest training motif only when its complete training frame strictly beats all five exact training baselines; fit Huffman on the same training symbols
design.test: freeze both models; charge exact test headers, motif placements, and residuals; report conditional and once-model-charged gain relative to frozen Huffman, including negative results
design.controls: test the learned order and a reordered test with identical label counts; mutate guard and tail; retain rows with no admitted training motif and zero test occurrences
design.verification: independent serialized bit lengths, exact decoder round trip without training, fit isolation, limits, malformed inputs, and three-platform installed conformance

limits: synthetic within-snapshot transfer fixtures only. Statistical calibration, temporal transfer, dictionary growth, and structural scores remain open.
